algorithm: default_rng(10105); random integer demands 38..60; random route mask p=0.50 with chain backbone and at least two incoming arcs per store; route costs random 7..30 plus an index distance component; initial capacities are balanced as ceil(total demand / warehouse count)+4, expanded together if needed; a cheapest-allowed-arc allocation is retained as a constructive feasibility certificate; feasibility is independently checked with linprog/HiGHS.
assumptions: Continuous flow quantities represent aggregated shipments.
Every store demand is met exactly.
Warehouse supply is an upper bound and unused supply is allowed.
Forbidden routes are excluded from decision variables.
No route capacity, fixed activation cost, time window, or loss is modeled.
feasibility_check: Passed by a separate zero-cost transportation LP before saving data.
